description: Decommissioned Royal Cambodian Air Force MiG-21 moved to the Gendarmerie training centre in October 2021 for display; Cambodia's MiG-21 fleet has been non-operational since about 2000. The registration is published as MF-7121; MF is the variant designator and 7121 the bort number so they are split across the variant and tail_number fields here. Reported by Thai PBS Verify in a fact-check published to debunk a claim that the aircraft was an operational threat
museum_name: Phnom Chum Gendarmerie Training Center Aircraft Display
